name: Narcooo/inkos
methodology_note: Repo-surface track: this product is distributed as a repository (library/CLI) with no web product surface, so the score derives ONLY from measurable public-repository signals — documentation, licensing, maintenance activity, releases, traction, agent-consumability. Each checklist item carries its evidence. Score ceiling 82/100: VITAL requires hands-on behavioral testing that repo signals cannot provide. Replaces a 2026-06/07 stub that carried a default score with no evidence.

checklist.task: Maintained: pushed within 12 months and not archived
Agent-consumable surface documented (MCP config or CLI install)

summary: Narcooo/inkos — Story Creation AI Agent for novel, scripts, translation, interactive games, and IP content. Repo-surface review: measured from the public repository (8023 stars, AGPL-3.0, last push 2026-07-16); not hands-on tested.

hlido_opinion.headline: A fast-moving, heavily-starred story-creation agent — real momentum and releases, but missing install docs and carrying a heavy issue backlog under an AGPL license.
hlido_opinion.body: The momentum here is genuine: 8k stars, a v1.7.0 release and a push on the very day the repository was measured. It is AGPL-3.0, TypeScript, with CI present, and its creative scope is broad — novels, scripts, translation, interactive games and IP content. Two honest cautions surface from the repository. The README lacks clear install/usage markers, which is a real onboarding gap for a project this popular, and 205 open issues is a large backlog to weigh against the fast release cadence. AGPL-3.0 is the licensing consideration for any commercial embedding. Repo-surface read; output quality was not tested hands-on.

tier_rationale: STEADY (80). Strong traction, active maintenance, CI and a real release cadence clear STEADY. VITAL is withheld because onboarding docs are missing, the open-issue backlog is heavy, and no agent-consumable interface or hands-on quality signal is present.
what_it_does_well: Very active — a push the same day it was measured — with tagged releases (v1.7.0)
Strong traction (8k stars) and CI present
Broad creative scope (novels, scripts, translation, games, IP content)
what_it_fails_at: No clear install/usage documentation in the README — an onboarding gap
205 open issues — a heavy backlog against the release cadence
Not exposed as an agent-consumable API; output quality unverified
best_for: Writers and creators wanting an AI story-creation tool
not_recommended_for: Closed commercial embedding wary of AGPL copyleft
Teams needing turnkey install and support
Agent pipelines needing a programmatic interface

agent_relevance.agent_integration_path: A story-creation agent with no documented programmatic surface for agent consumption at the repository level. No hands-on behavioral test performed.
